```{python}

import os 
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(override=True)

api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")

if not api_key: 
  print("Heads up. No API key was found.")
elif not api_key.startswith("sk-proj-"):
  print("Heas up. an API key was found but it doesn't start with sk-proj")
else: 
  print("a valid API key found")
```

```{python}
from aiohttp import payload
import requests

headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {
  "model": "gpt-5-nano",
  "messages":[
    {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a fun fact!"}
  ]
}
payload

```

```{python}
response = requests.post(
  "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
  headers = headers,
  json= payload
)

response.json()
```

```{python}
response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
response.json()["id"] ## to get the content of the response to have insight into the json output 

```

1. create openai client 
  . make sure to change the model as gpt-6-luman might be very expensive 

```{python}
from openai import OpenAI
openai = OpenAI()

response = openai.chat.completions.create(model = "gpt-6-luna", messages=[
  {"role":"user", "content": "Tell me a fun fact!!"}
])

response.choices[0].message.content

```

Checking for google api key 

```{python}
GEMINI_BASE_URL = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/"

from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(override = True)
google_api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")

if not google_api_key: 
  print("Google API key was not found.")
elif not google_api_key.startswith(("AIz", "AQ.")):
    print("An API key was found, but it doesn't start with AIz or AQ.")
else: 
  print("Your google api key is ready to use.")

```


```{python}
gemini = OpenAI(base_url=GEMINI_BASE_URL, api_key=google_api_key)
Google_model = "gemini-3.8-flash"

response = gemini.chat.completions.create(model = Google_model, messages=[{"role":"user", "content": "Tell me a Fun Fact!"}])

response.choices[0].message.content

```
